p-n-p transistor: A p-n-p transistor is a junction transistor having an n-type semiconductor between a p-type semiconductor that serves as an emitter and a p-type semiconductor that serves as a collector.
p-n junction: A p-n junction is the junction between a p-type semiconductor and an n-type semiconductor.
For example: "A p-n junction has marked rectifying characteristics."
p-type semiconductor: A p-type semiconductor is a semiconductor in which electrical conduction is due chiefly to the movement of positive holes.
